senses.gloss: आमोक्षण आमोक्षण, i. e. आ-मोक्ष् + अन (v. r.), n. Binding on, Rām. 2, 23, 39, Schl.
आमोचन आमोचन, i. e. आ-मुच् + अन, n. Binding on, Rām. 2, 20, 43 Gorr.

आमोद आमोद, i. e. आ-मुद् + अ, m.
 1. Pleasure, Kir. 5, 26.
 2. A fragrancy, strong smell, Ṛt. 6, 34.
 --Comp.
ऽआमोदिन् -आमोदिन्, i. e. आ-मुद् + इन्, adj. Smelling, Rājat. 5, 357.
अ-मोघ- + बल अ-मोघ- + बल, adj. of unfailing power.
अ-मोघ- + महिमन् अ-मोघ- + महिमन्, adj. possessing a greatness which is not devoid of effect.

अ- + मोघ अ- + मोघ,
 I. adj., f. घा, not vain, not going astray, unfailing, Vikr. d. 88; attaining one's aim, efficacious, Megh. 72.
 II. f. घा. 1. the name of a club, Rām. 1, 29, 12. 2. the name of several plants. 3. a proper name.
अ-मोघ- + वाच् अ-मोघ- + वाच्, adj. one whose speech is not idle.
अ-मोघ- + वीर्य अ-मोघ- + वीर्य, adj. 1. of unfailing virility. 2. of unfailing power.
